shadows.name: minimal
shadows.value: 0 0 0 1px var(--border), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-shadow-color) 6%, transparent), 0 3px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-shadow-color) 6%, transparent)

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--background), 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ring), 0 0 6px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 25%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus; the 1px surface spacer keeps the ring off the control edge.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Entering surfaces; swift arrival, no overshoot.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Single-column shell and mobile menu page.

scale.note: Contract tiers are machine-checked in DESIGN.md frontmatter and scripts/scale-contract.ts.

narrative.northStar: An operator's console: a cool, quiet workspace where agent sessions, files and tools share one continuous surface.
narrative.overview: Phaneris is ink on paper, not chrome on glass. Backgrounds are white or blue-graphite; the only saturated color is the violet accent, reserved for focus and selection. Space, surface luminance and a single hairline separate things. Motion describes causality, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Cool neutrality with one saturated accent
Small radii and physical, causal motion
Text scale and control geometry governed by a checked contract

rules.name: The Accent-Is-For-Intent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks focus, selection and the active control. It never fills large surfaces or decorates text.

rules.name: The Scale-Is-Spoken Rule
rules.body: Any font size, control height or radius comes from the contract tiers (or a semantic role token). Adding a value starts in DESIGN.md and scale-contract.ts, never in a component.

rules.name: The Single-Border Rule
rules.body: Along any sight line into a surface, at most one closed border. Controls inside a bordered container drop to ghost/filled.

rules.name: The Quiet-Stream Rule
rules.body: Streamed text appears directly; the reading position stays stable. No per-character or blur streaming effects.

dos: Route every visual value through a token or a contract tier.
Keep the accent for intent; use neutral surfaces for content.
Verify both modes and all three hosts (Electron, WebUI, Viewer).
donts: Don't introduce per-character or blur streaming effects.
Don't write text-[13px], rounded-[8px], h-[30px] or inline colors.
Don't add a second implementation of a menu, empty state or roving-focus protocol.
Don't change the settled identity: white paper and ink, violet accent, neutral user bubble, 6px base radius.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; foreground fill with background text.
components.css: .ds-btn { height: var(--control-height-md); padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--shape-control); background: var(--foreground); color: var(--background); font: 500 var(--type-label-size)/1.5 var(--font-sans); transition: opacity var(--motion-duration-standard) var(--motion-ease-enter); } .ds-btn:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--background), 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ring); }

components.name: Ghost Toolbar Button
components.description: Inside a bordered container; transparent until hover.
components.css: .ds-ghost { height: var(--control-height-xs); border: 0; border-radius: var(--shape-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: background var(--motion-duration-fast) var(--motion-ease-enter), color var(--motion-duration-fast) var(--motion-ease-enter); } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--action-hover); color: var(--text-primary); } .ds-ghost:active { background: var(--action-pressed); }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The conversation input; one closed border, role radius, three shadow states.
components.css: .ds-composer { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: var(--shape-composer); background: var(--input); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / .035), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border); font: 400 var(--type-body-size)/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-composer:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .06), inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 20%, transparent); } .ds-composer:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .08), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ring), 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ring); }

components.name: User Message
components.description: Neutral bubble, no border, reading rhythm.
components.css: .ds-bubble { max-width: 80%; padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: var(--shape-bubble); background: var(--user-message-bubble); color: var(--text-primary); font: 400 var(--type-reading-size)/1.7 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Activity Row
components.description: One tool step inside a turn; no closed border.
components.css: .ds-activity { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: var(--shape-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 var(--type-label-size)/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-activity:hover { background: var(--action-hover); } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--success); } .ds-meta { margin-left: auto; color: var(--text-tertiary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal with one border ring and strong elevation.
components.css: .ds-dialog { max-width: 420px; padding: 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-card); background: var(--popover-solid); color: var(--text-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-strong); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 var(--type-title-size)/1.45 var(--font-sans); } .ds-dialog p { margin: 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font: 400 var(--type-body-size)/1.5 var(--font-sans); }
